hints.title: Opportunity Cost Comparison
hints.text: Consider the cost difference of sending person i to city A instead of city B: delta = costA - costB. Smaller delta values represent stronger preference for city A.

hints.title: Sort by Cost Delta
hints.text: Sort all 2N people in ascending order of (costA - costB). The first N people yield the greatest relative savings when sent to city A.

hints.title: Split Partition Sum
hints.text: After sorting by cost delta, assign the first N people to city A and the remaining N people to city B. Sum their corresponding travel costs to produce the minimum total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of candidates (2N total people)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all (2N choose N) combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by relative marginal savings achieves optimal assignment in O(N log N) time and O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize opportunity cost greedy ranking by delta = costA - costB.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N) using quickselect to partition the N smallest deltas.
